description.value: Galiano Italiano Marketplace is a specialty Italian food shop in Sechelt that carries on the legacy of the Old Boot Eatery, a community favourite established in 1995 and now reimagined in a new space. Cyclists can pick up housemade prepared pasta dishes — chicken dijon, prawn linguini, lasagna — plus desserts like tiramisu and Nanaimo bars, and bulk case-lot items to take away. The shop also features an antique collection of vintage collectibles curated by owner Danny, adding an unexpected layer of local character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms 'Galiano Italiano Marketplace' is a specialty Italian prepared-food shop located in Sechelt on the Sunshine Coast mainland — not on Galiano Island despite the name. Product offerings are housemade pastas, desserts, and case-lot bulk Italian items for takeaway, with a 'Frozen Products' category suggesting much stock is refrigerated/frozen rather than fresh produce, making the OSM 'greengrocer' tag inaccurate. No cycling infrastructure (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) is mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Galiano Italiano Market' does not match website name 'Galiano Italiano Marketplace'.

Business is located in Sechelt (Sunshine Coast mainland), not on Galiano Island — the name 'Galiano Italiano' likely references an Italian family heritage rather than a geographic location; OSM community classification 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' may be incorrect.
OSM opening hours (Tu-Fr 11:00-17:30) conflict with website, which states open 'EVERY Friday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.' only — website implies Friday-only operation.
OSM category 'greengrocer' is inaccurate; the business sells prepared Italian meals, frozen/refrigerated pasta dishes, and desserts, not fresh produce.
OSM had no phone number; (604) 885-9870 sourced solely from the website contact page and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a specialty Italian prepared-food marketplace in Sechelt with no confirmed cycling amenities and very limited operating hours; its value to touring cyclists is uncertain and warrants on-the-ground verification before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The shop is the successor to the Old Boot Eatery (est. 1995), a long-running Sunshine Coast community institution that closed and has been relaunched under the Galiano Italiano brand.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as 'greengrocer' but the business is a specialty Italian prepared-food marketplace selling housemade pasta dishes, desserts, and case-lot bulk items — not fresh produce. A category of 'Specialty Food / Deli' would be more accurate.
